scope: Read-only exact v2 proposal delta, static path/dispatch/security/error review; no source edits or workloads.

conclusions.detail: Exact type branch precedes raw root/join evaluation. All subclasses execute original self.store lookup then original candidate join/guard/resolves; v1 eager-dispatch issue fixed.
Base root normalized and anchored by unchanged post-init. Raw store/candidate construction and lexical relative checks perform no filesystem resolution or access.

Only lexically contained/equal candidates without relative .. components use raw_store fast path. Absolute outside paths and traversal retain original self.store prefix check, closing linked-store/absolute-target counterexample. Absolute inside/equal paths remain covered by candidate ancestry.

Full fresh candidate guard checks candidate and every ancestor including ordinary store/root; both filesystem resolves and exact containment condition are unchanged. No state read, mutation or trust operation follows without that guard.
Public store, contained, root normalization, all other methods, atomic write/recovery guards, commit and approval behavior byte unchanged. No path/root/metadata cache added.

error_and_race_semantics: Unexpected metadata errors fail closed through unchanged final full ancestry guard. Missing descendants are still tolerated by guard and both resolves remain strict=False.

Base fast path changes error precedence when a candidate and prefix both fail, and can observe different transient filesystem mutations because the early prefix pass is omitted. This is not a claim of identical race/error chronology; fresh pre-resolution ancestry guard remains authoritative.
No race-free guarantee introduced; existing guard-then-resolve/IO TOCTOU limits remain. Dynamic monkeypatching of base-class descriptors is outside the subclass-dispatch guarantee.
required_targeted_cases: one full guard for ordinary base descendants and fresh guard on repeated calls
real store/root-ancestor/candidate symlink or junction rejected
linked store plus absolute outside store-equal target rejected via fallback
relative parent traversal and unrelated absolute target retain fallback/denial
missing descendants and empty parts/store-equal candidate accepted when otherwise safe
custom subclass alternate store retained and subclass denial before raw root access/invalid joins
unexpected metadata permission/OSError propagate before downstream operation
limitations: Proposal unapplied at capture; no targeted tests verified yet.
No 5-second browser cure, performance improvement, full contract closure, installed artifact binding or release certification claimed.
Existing browser failures and raw diagnostic evidence remain unchanged historical captures.
